statement.zh: Zechenter 1988 苏佩谷生计模型反对「海洋资源为唯一基础」；并参与内陆纪念性遗址早期测年/识别脉络（后与卡拉尔集群关联）。
statement.en: Zechenter 1988 Supe Valley subsistence modeling rejects maritime resources as an exclusive base and contributes early inland monumental-site dating/recognition later linked to the Caral cluster.
